name: tripweaver
description: AI travel planner that co-designs itineraries with users, then generates a zoomable map, a route image with a text itinerary, and hand-drawn shareable posters.

displayDescription.en: Co-designs itineraries with you, then generates a zoomable map, a route image with a text itinerary, and hand-drawn posters you can share.
displayDescription.zh: 和你一起逐条敲定目的地、天数、预算与偏好，定制专属行程，一键生成可缩放地图、带文字行程的路线图，以及可直接发朋友圈的手绘旅行海报。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想规划一次旅行，请一步步帮我确认细节，最后生成可缩放地图、带文字行程的路线图和可分享的旅行海报。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to plan a trip. Help me confirm the details step by step, then generate a zoomable map, a route image with a text itinerary, and shareable travel posters.

quickPrompts.en: I want to plan a trip. Help me confirm the details step by step, then generate a zoomable map, a route image with a text itinerary, and shareable travel posters.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想规划一次旅行，请一步步帮我确认细节，最后生成可缩放地图、带文字行程的路线图和可分享的旅行海报。

quickPrompts.en: 5 days in Chengdu: food + slow living
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我在成都规划 5 天，主打美食和慢生活的行程

quickPrompts.en: Turn this itinerary into hand-drawn posters I can share
quickPrompts.zh: 把这份行程做成可以发朋友圈的手绘海报
出发前帮我查一下实时天气，并更新出行清单
